newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGE to sell Canal Plus stake to Havas.
newsitem.headline: CGE to sell Canal Plus stake to Havas.

text.p: Compagnie Generale des Eaux will sell its 19.3 percent stake in pay-television broadcast group Canal Plus to Havas for 5.6 billion francs ($1 billion), the two parent companies announced at a news conference.

Generale des Eaux will also sell its Generale d'Images unit to Havas for 526 million francs. In return, Generale des Eaux will receive shares to increase its stake in Havas to 20 percent from 2.1 percent.
It will buy a further 10 percent stake from Alcatel Alsthom , bringing its total stake in Havas to 30 percent, they said. ($ = 5.581 French Francs)
CGE to sell Canal Plus stake =2
In addition, Compagnie Generale des Eaux will sell its 10 percent stake in CanalSatellite to Canal Plus or a third party designated by Canal Plus, the statement said.
And the utility group's cable activities will be sold this year to a partner chosen in consultation with Havas and Canal Plus, it added.

The two parent companies said the agreement showed their joint determination to create a major French communications and multimedia group which would be one of the leading European companies in the fast-growing audio-visual sector.

Havas Chairman Pierre Dauzier told a news conference Havas would own 34.4 percent of Canal Plus after that company's merger with Nethold. He said his group would act in concert with Societe Generale controlling a 40 percent block.
